description: One recipient record of an honest 4 slot frame, change in slot 0, payments in slots 1 and 3, an exit in slot 2. body is the first 105 ciphertext bytes of the slot 1 record u8(1) || u64be(body_amount) || body_owner_key || body_mint || be32(body_blinding) || be32(body_nullifier_pk) under label CRING/rcp and body_slot_secret, the CRDS slot secret of recipient_keys[body_index] and body_index, with no payload. recipient_keys[0] is the sender's own key for its change, the sender reads every recipient_u from the auditor stream. body, recipient_keys and the record fields are produced by prover/ringtest/ringprotocol/anonymous_bodies_vector_test.go with WRITE_AUDIT_VECTORS=1, the keys and the slot secret stay pinned in the file.
